csv_project_name: Planning & Design Engrg for Maintenance Facility Space Needs
csv_scope_of_work: City of Fitchburg maybe seeking Planning/Design/Engr for Demolish three existing buildings (old salt shed, middle storage shed, old PW garage/fire station), which are currently used for cold storage. Construct additional space for the purposes of providing maintenance and repairs to City vehicles and equipment as well as storing vehicles and equipment for Streets, Parks, and Utilities. It will also serve as the base of operations for the Streets, Parks, and Utility crews. Material storage bins would also be included as a function external to the expansion.

title: Planning and Design Engineering for Maintenance Facility Space Needs
short_description: Planning and design for a new municipal maintenance and operations facility expansion.
project_scope: Demolition of three existing cold-storage buildings (old salt shed, middle storage shed, old public works garage/fire station) and construction of additional maintenance facility space for repair and storage of city vehicles and equipment for Streets, Parks, and Utilities operations, including external material storage bins and operational base functions for municipal crews.
services: Architecture services, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, programming, civil engineering, and planning/master planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Municipal maintenance/operations building, not a bridge, stadium, or special long-span structure.
- Scope is primarily general building planning with architecture and civil engineering.
- Could involve a larger utilitarian facility, but no structural complexity, span, or innovative lightweight features are stated.
- Early planning/design stage offers some strategic entry, yet project type is only moderately aligned with sbp's core profile.
